question: Which of the following is the correct option for using 'justify' alignment to a paragraph in a document?

options.text: Aligns text only to the left
Aligns text only to the right
Aligns text to both left and right edges

solution:
The correct answer is __**Aligns text to both left and right edges**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Justify alignment** adjusts the spacing between words so that the text is aligned evenly along both the left and right margins.
 
• This creates a clean and formal look for the text, often used in newspapers, magazines, and documents where neatness is important.
